_comment: PostToolUse hook: append every Bash command the agent runs to the active provenance manifest. Merge the `hooks` block into ~/.claude/settings.json (all projects) or <repo>/.claude/settings.json (one repo). Prefer install_hook.py, which merges safely and is idempotent.
_authoritative_schema: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks-guide -- if that page disagrees with the block below, trust the page. Some versions also offer an interactive /hooks command, which writes this for you.
_project_variant: For a project-local install replace $HOME/.claude with ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.claude so the hook uses the project's own copy of the skill.
_limits: Captures the command string only: not its exit code, its inputs or its outputs. It is a floor, not a substitute for explicit `step` calls -- a hook cannot know which file was an input and which a deliverable, nor that a substitution was a deviation. It skips its own calls and bare navigation commands; set PROVENANCE_LOG_ALL=1 to record everything.
_privacy: Command strings may contain credentials. provenance.py redacts named secret assignments and known token shapes on a best-effort basis only -- review a manifest before committing it.
